text:
marta: Seeing a pattern of cross-region LB retries and 503s from eu-central -> us-east starting ~04:12 UTC. Spike aligns with a deployment.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260418-02 opened, paging network oncall.
ryan: Can you share the LB routing logs and the config diff from the deploy?
marta: Logs show many 5xx responses with backend connection reset and `x-forwarded-for` preserved, but origin region was us-east for many requests that started in eu-central. Diff: changed route policy to prefer cheapest region fallback (cost-aware routing) at 04:10.
devin: That policy change should have respected geographic affinity. Might be a bug in weight calculation that favored cross-region endpoints when local capacity briefly dipped.
networking: If routing is preferring cross-region under short capacity blips, that increases RTT and TLS handshake retries. We should revert policy to previous behavior while we investigate.
ops-sre: Agreed. Initiating immediate rollback of cost-aware fallback policy to previous weight map. Rolling to canary pools first.
marta: Canary rollback applied to eu-central pool; retries and 503s dropped to baseline in ~90s. Rolling region-wide.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: rollback-policy applied (rev 20260418-8) to eu-central.
ryan: Owners: Devin = bug lead (routing weight calc fix + unit tests), Networking = policy review + rollout safeguards, Ops-sre = rollback runbook and alert tuning. Marta = postmortem doc + customer impact notes.
networking: Short-term actions: revert (done), add an automated pre-deploy simulation that runs routing decisions against sample traffic (infra + networking). Mid-term: telemetry for cross-region route fraction per minute. Long-term: circuit-breaker for cross-region failover to avoid amplifying blips.
devin: I'll open PRs: routing fix + simulation harness. ETA for patch: 2026-04-20 EOD. Also adding regression test with synthetic capacity drop.
ops-sre: Monitoring: add alert if cross-region traffic fraction > 5% for more than 2m and latency > 200ms. Also add a runbook step to check recent routing policy changes on deploy.
marta: Scheduling postmortem meeting 2026-04-19 10:30 UTC. Oncall-bot set reminder.
oncall-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem meeting scheduled 2026-04-19 10:30 UTC.
ryan: Note: check if customers saw elevated error rates; Marta please draft comms if needed.
marta: Will do. Postmortem draft will include timeline, RCA (bug in weight calc + insufficient preflight), mitigations, owners, and follow-up tasks. Draft by EOD.
networking: Add a 4-week recurrence watch; report weekly on cross-region patterns.
ops-sre: Runbook updated with rollback commands and verification steps. Closing loop for now.
